# harness-retro

> harness-retro is an open-source (Apache-2.0) retrospective workflow for Claude Code. When an AI coding agent repeats a mistake, it reads the session transcript, looks for the likely cause, drafts three candidate fixes to rule files (such as CLAUDE.md) or tests, tests each one in a bubblewrap sandbox, passes four review checks, and changes nothing until a human approves one exact, digest-bound candidate.

Requirements: Python 3.11 or 3.12, Git, a compatible `claude` CLI, and Linux with bubblewrap. The default policy is report-only. Strong isolation is Linux-only. The bundled incidents are synthetic teaching examples, not real user data. During a run, recent session messages are sent to the model through the user's own `claude` CLI, and the model gets read-only access to the repository, parts of the harness (`~/.claude`, or `RETRO2_HOME` when set: `CLAUDE.md`, `settings.json`, `hooks`, and `scripts/logs`), and the diagnostics directory (`/tmp/retro2-diagnostics` by default). Diagnosis starts from an empty filesystem and mounts only that allow-list. A file elsewhere in the home directory is not mounted. If the project directory is `$HOME` or the harness directory, only the listed harness files from that tree are mounted. The Claude credential is mounted read-only under `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` on the sandbox `/tmp`, not at its original path. The Claude backend does not mount Codex's `auth.json`. When the Codex backend is selected, Codex's read-only sandbox blocks writes, not reads. `auth.json` is mounted read-only at `$CODEX_HOME/auth.json` under that `/tmp`, not at `~/.codex/auth.json`, including when the project directory is `$HOME`. The model can still read that file if it reaches the `CODEX_HOME` path.

- [README](https://github.com/zealchou/harness-retro/blob/main/README.md): what it does, quick start, the full configuration table, FAQ
- [Architecture](https://github.com/zealchou/harness-retro/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): the seven stations and data flow
- [Safety model](https://github.com/zealchou/harness-retro/blob/main/docs/safety-model.md): threat model, protected paths, approval binding, rollback
- [Example run](https://github.com/zealchou/harness-retro/blob/main/docs/example-run.md): a de-identified walk-through from incident to approval
- [Writing incidents](https://github.com/zealchou/harness-retro/blob/main/docs/writing-incidents.md): how to build your own incident bank

## Code

- [Controller entry](https://github.com/zealchou/harness-retro/blob/main/retro2/controller/run.py): the only controller entry point
- [Configuration](https://github.com/zealchou/harness-retro/blob/main/retro2/config.py): portable filesystem defaults and most environment variables (see the README configuration table for the full list)
- [Example hook settings](https://github.com/zealchou/harness-retro/blob/main/examples/settings.json): opt-in context-pressure hook for Claude Code
